title: Three Terms and One Short Rule
subtitle: 语言文化 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 语言文化（人与社会·历史社会与文化·语言与文化）
meta: 主题语境：语言文化（人与社会·历史社会与文化·语言与文化）　|　核心词汇：grammar　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 grammar 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1961 the teacher ① taught the grammar that no pupil in the room would have described, and he said the teaching was the whole of the term. The ② grammar, meaning the rules themselves and not the words, ran three terms and stayed undescribed in the book; grammar, he said, is the only thing in a room that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ kind of grammar in that room had the same short rule beside it, and the ④ grammar at the far board, meaning the one they kept for the children and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Grammar, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the teacher said the describing is the part that fills three terms.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the grammar was the whole of the matter, meaning the order and not the rules. The ⑥ grammar, meaning the order and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; grammar, he said, is either something you teach or the only word that means both a rule and an order. He said the order is the part they remember.

By 1966 the ⑦ grammar had become a line in a book, and the book had become an argument about the short rule. The ⑧ grammar of the whole thing, the teacher wrote in November, was one room and three terms of describing; grammar, he said, is either the one at the far board or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ grammar I remember is the grammar described in the book, which closed in 1968 and is still described as the quietest in the room. ⑩ Grammar, my mother said in 1970, is the only study that improves by being described; all grammar, she said, is an order that has agreed to look like a rule. She said the order was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 语法（指教室里每一种旁边的那一种）
B. n. 语法（指那些规则本身，与词语相对）
C. 固定搭配：teach the grammar 教语法
D. n. 语法（指留给孩子们学的那一套）
E. n. 语法（抽象总称，指一间教室的语法教学之事）
F. n. 语法（指课本里写到、被记下的那一套）
G. n. 文法；基本原理（the grammar of a craft，指一件事里人人都用却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 章法（抽象总称，指人人都用却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: taught the grammar that no pupil in the room would have described
The grammar, meaning the rules themselves and not the words
Every kind of grammar in that room
the grammar at the far board
the grammar was the whole of the matter
the grammar had become a line in a book
The grammar of the whole thing

answers.why: teach the grammar 意为“教语法”，1961 年那位老师教了教室里没有一位学生肯描述的语法。
grammar 意为“语法”，指那些规则本身而不是词语，它经过了三个学期而在簿子上没有被描述。
grammar 意为“语法”，指教室里每一种旁边的那一种，每一种旁边都有同一条矮矮的规则。
grammar 意为“语法”，指最远那块板上留给孩子们学的那一套，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
grammar 意为“文法、基本原理”，指一件事里人人都用却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这套章法就是那件事的全部。
grammar 意为“章法”，指人人都用却无人提起的那样东西而不是那些语法规则，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
grammar 意为“语法”，指课本里写到、被记下的那一套，到 1966 年这一套成了课本里的一行。
grammar 意为“语法”，老师十一月写道，整件事的语法教学之事是一间教室和三个学期的描述。
grammar 意为“语法”，我记得的是课本里描述过的那一套，1968 年学完了，至今仍被说成教室里最安静的一套。
grammar 为抽象总称，母亲 1970 年说，语法是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的学问。
